race.title: Happy 70th David Clements Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: MWABANI put his experience to good use when making a winning return in good style at Chepstow 6 weeks ago and with the prospect of more to come now handicapping, Jane Williams' charge makes plenty of appeal from an opening mark of 115. Treasure Planet would have finished closer but for a late error at Newbury latest and rates next best ahead of Wetherby scorer Washington . MWABANI (FR) TREASURE PLANET (IRE) WASHINGTON
race.bettingForecast: Mwabani (7/4), Washington (9/4), Handlethekettle (7/2), Treasure Planet (5/1), Son Of Hypnos (20/1)
